title: 第19章 有些无奈的巧合第20章 戴夫.琼斯的烦恼
content_zh:
第019章 有些无奈的巧合
回到俱乐部之后，王利又开始了每天不间断的训练生活。
当初晨的朝阳冉冉升起的时候，他就从打坐中苏醒过来，开始做些体能训练，体能并不是一天两天可以锻炼出来的，拥有前世记忆的王利更是对次深为了解。
少林寺的僧人习武之前都要在寺中挑半年的水，做半年的苦工，最后还要进行考核，只有通过者方才有资格学习最基础的罗汉拳，所以不论习武又或是踢球是同一个道理，体能训练是绝对不能有丝毫懈怠的。
吃过早饭后，他就开始和队友一起做日常训练，这段时间可以说是王利一天中最清闲的时光，老伍德交代的任务并不繁重，那种日常的体能锻炼相对于杰森.巴伯先生给他制定的训练完全不在一个档次，而王利参加日常训练的主要目的，便是练习和队友的短传配合，以及战术意识等等，这样便可以把斯蒂芬.库帕教授他的战术、走位等知识实际的运用到比赛之中。
中午昨晚体能训练之后，他便回到宿舍继续打坐修炼内力，下午随队训练之后还要帮助托马斯练习守门能力...
这种生活对普通人来讲确实十分枯燥、乏味，很少有人能坚持下来，但王利却乐在其中并且感到很充实，他仿佛又回到了前世在灵柩宫中和师傅虚竹子一起修炼的日子，虚竹子对他的说教和关心、怒斥和鼓励都深深的埋藏在他的心里。
不过，他已经不可能回到那个世界了，他也只能在生活中享受这种充实的生活来进行回忆，他甚至会怕这个纸金迷醉的世界会消磨了他的斗志...
在这种生活中，王利得到了战术教练斯蒂芬.库帕以及体能教练杰森.巴伯的一致好感。
每个老师都希望自己的学生是一个好学、肯努力的人，显然王利就是这种人。
本来，杰森.巴伯为王利制定的体能训练是有个范围的，而他没想到的是，这个刚刚加入俱乐部的十六岁少年居然每天都能坚持完成最大量的训练，这让他有些吃惊，要知道，那种运动量也只有英超联赛中体能极好的球员才能完成，而王利却刚刚只有16岁。
吃惊之后，便是欣赏了，现在，这种能吃苦的少年已经很少很少了，而想要成为一名真正的巨星，就必须能够有坚强的毅力，显然，这个黑发的东方小子已经具备了这点。而天分？在伊斯兰尔球场上，上演两次杂耍般的舞蹈的球员会没有天分？说出来谁也不会相信的...
斯蒂芬.库帕每个星期五都会为王利专门上一节战术指导课，在开始的时候，他有些不耐烦的发现这个黑发小子几乎对战术一窍不通！这甚至让他有些恼怒，想象一下，让一个大学教授去给一个六岁孩童讲解初中知识会是什么情景？他也只能从最基本的意识，走位讲起，并且也只能无奈的要求加课，谁让自己已经答应老伍德了呢，他颇为无奈的想到...
不过，随着这种讲解的深入，斯蒂芬.库伯发现这个叫艾伦.王的少年确实很是认真，他有一丝的不理解都会努力的向自己求教，又或是争辩，有时候甚至能让斯蒂芬感觉自己是不是错的一方？在这种争辩中，他对于战术的理解也更加深入了，所以他有些喜欢上了这个学生，不过，这种学生只有一点不好，他的学习能力太强了，斯蒂芬感觉，如果这种课程持续几个月之后，他就没什么可教了...
他感到了作为教育者的悲哀。
......
时间就如同流星一般，转瞬即逝，很快，就过了两个多月。
在这两个月中，伍尔弗汉普顿青年队，凭借老伍德指定的长传冲吊523战术，几乎横扫英格兰各个低级联赛球队，有了王利源源不断的长传支援，皮特.卡斯、哈利尔森.克拉尔强势的霸占了英格兰青年联赛的射手榜的前两名，而王利也成为了英格兰略有名气的新星，不过比起皮特.卡斯以及哈利尔森的鼎鼎大名，他却变的有些默默无闻了。
在这段时间，王利再也没有上演什么精彩表演，上次在伊斯兰尔球场的内力枯竭，导致了他半个月的修为几乎付之东流，所以在内力达到初窥门径以前，他决定再也不为了这种无所谓胜负的比赛拼命了，要知道他绝对不是一个无私的人...
在比赛场上很少使用内力的后果便是...除了一脚长传、偶尔展现精彩的带球过人之外，他变的有些一无是处了，这也导致那些从前窥视他的各个俱乐部也都放弃掉了，他们也只能感叹，又一个‘天才’的坠落...

斯蒂芬.伯格的战术课，早在一个星期以前就已经停止了。
斯蒂芬已经没有什么战术相关的只是可以传授给他了，这让年仅三十几岁的斯蒂芬想起了一个中国的词汇“关门弟子”，王利就是他的关门弟子，他已经把毕生所学全部传授给了这个关门弟子，不过这么年轻的斯蒂芬...
而杰森.巴伯为他指定的体能训练也暂时告一段落，经过两个多月的锻炼以及每天坚持不懈的内力修炼，他的身体已经打磨的很强壮了，至少也可以和普通的英超球员相媲美，对于王利身体这种明显的进步，杰森,巴伯很是欣慰，王利的成功也就是他的成功，这可以为他以后的工作提供很大的帮助。
而今天却是一个重要的日子，王利的内力修为已经积攒到了一定程度，小无相功就要突破第一个瓶颈了。
在突破初窥门径阶段时，并没有什么危险，但是却需要一个绝对安全的环境修炼大概一天左右，显然在俱乐部的宿舍内修炼是极其不适合的，所以早上王利便让托马斯帮他请个假，他要去找个安静的酒店来突破瓶颈。
不过，他不知道的是，今天对于皮特.卡斯、哈利尔森以及他自己而言，也是另外一种重要的日子。
他们三个虽然早已被内定掉入一线队，但主教练戴夫.琼斯还是决定亲自来看看青年队的训练以表示他对球员们的关心，而王利却在今天请假了…
content_en:
Chapter 019 Some helpless coincidences
After returning to the club, Wang Li began his daily non-stop training life again.
When the sun rose in the morning, he woke up from meditation and began to do some physical training. Physical fitness cannot be developed in a day or two. Wang Li, who has memories of past lives, understands this very well.
Before practicing martial arts in Shaolin Temple, the monks have to carry water and do hard work for half a year in the temple. Finally, they have to take an assessment. Only those who pass are qualified to learn the most basic Luohan Quan. Therefore, whether practicing martial arts or playing football, the same principle applies. Physical training must not be slacked off at all.
After breakfast, he began to do daily training with his teammates. This period can be said to be Wang Li's most leisure time of the day. The tasks assigned by Old Wood were not onerous. The daily physical training was not at the same level as the training set for him by Mr. Jason Barber. The main purpose of Wang Li's participation in daily training was to practice short passing cooperation with teammates, as well as tactical awareness, etc., so that he could actually apply the tactics, positioning and other knowledge taught to him by Stephen Cooper into the game.
After the physical training at noon and last night, he returned to the dormitory to continue meditating to cultivate his internal strength. After training with the team in the afternoon, he also helped Thomas practice his goalkeeping skills...
This kind of life is indeed very boring and boring for ordinary people, and few people can persist in it, but Wang Li enjoys it and feels very fulfilled. He seems to have returned to the days when he practiced with his master Xu Zhuzi in the coffin palace in his previous life. Xu Zhuzi's preaching, care, anger and encouragement to him are all deeply buried in his heart.
However, it is impossible for him to return to that world. He can only enjoy this fulfilling life in life to remember. He is even afraid that this paper-gold world will kill his fighting spirit...
In this kind of life, Wang Li won the unanimous favor of tactical coach Stephen Cooper and physical fitness coach Jason Barber.
Every teacher hopes that his student will be a person who is eager to learn and willing to work hard, and Wang Li is obviously such a person.
Originally, the physical training set by Jason Barber for Wang Li had a certain range, but what he didn't expect was that this 16-year-old boy who had just joined the club could insist on completing the maximum amount of training every day, which surprised him. You know, that kind of exercise can only be completed by players with excellent physical fitness in the Premier League, and Wang Li was only 16 years old.
After being surprised, I came to appreciate it. Nowadays, there are very few young people like this who can endure hardships. If you want to become a real superstar, you must have strong perseverance. Obviously, this black-haired oriental boy already has this. And talent? Would a player who performs two acrobatic dances on the Ismail Stadium have no talent? No one would believe it...
Stephen Cooper would give Wang Li a special tactical instruction class every Friday. At the beginning, he was a little impatient to find that this black-haired boy knew almost nothing about tactics! This even made him a little angry. Imagine what it would be like to ask a university professor to explain junior high school knowledge to a six-year-old child? He could only start from the most basic consciousness and positioning, and he could only ask for extra classes helplessly. Who knew that he had already agreed to Old Wood? He thought rather helplessly...
However, as this explanation deepened, Stephen Cooper discovered that this young man named Allen Wang was indeed very serious. If he didn't understand at all, he would try to ask himself for advice, or argue, and sometimes even make Stephen feel that he was the wrong party? In this kind of argument, his understanding of tactics became more in-depth, so he fell in love with this student. However, there is only one bad thing about this kind of student. His learning ability is too strong.Tiffin felt that if this course continued for several months, he would have nothing left to teach...
He felt the sadness of being an educator.
...
Time is like a meteor, fleeting, and soon, more than two months have passed.
In the past two months, the Wolverhampton youth team, relying on the 523 long pass tactics designated by Old Wood, swept almost every lower league team in England. With Wang Li's continuous long pass support, Peter Cass and Harrelson Krall strongly occupied the top two scorers in the English Youth League. Wang Li has also become a slightly famous star in England, but compared to the famous names of Peter Cass and Harrelson, he has become somewhat unknown.
During this period of time, Wang Li never put on any exciting performances. The last time he had exhausted his internal energy at the Islamic Stadium, almost half a month of his cultivation was in vain. So before his internal energy reached the first level, he decided not to fight for such a game that didn't matter whether he won or lost. You must know that he is definitely not a selfless person...
The consequence of rarely using his internal strength on the field is that...except for long passes and occasionally wonderful dribbling, he has become somewhat useless. This has also caused the clubs that had peeked at him in the past to give up. They can only lament that another 'genius' has fallen...
Stephen Berg's tactics class had stopped a week ago.
Stephen had nothing to teach him about tactics anymore. This reminded Stephen, who was only in his thirties, of a Chinese term "closed disciple." Wang Li was his closed disciple. He had taught all he had learned in his life to this closed disciple, but such a young Stephen...
The physical training designated for him by Jason Barber has come to an end for the time being. After more than two months of training and unremitting internal strength training every day, his body has been polished to be very strong, at least comparable to ordinary Premier League players. Jason Barber is very pleased with Wang Li's obvious improvement in his body. Wang Li's success is also his success, which can provide a lot of help for his future work.
But today is an important day. Wang Li's internal strength has been accumulated to a certain level, and Xiaowuxiang Gong is about to break through the first bottleneck.
There is no danger when breaking through the first glimpse of the threshold, but it requires an absolutely safe environment to practice for about a day. Obviously, practicing in the club's dormitory is extremely unsuitable, so in the morning Wang Li asked Thomas to ask for a leave for him. He wanted to find a quiet hotel to break through the bottleneck.
However, what he didn't know was that today was another important day for Peter Cass, Harrelson and himself.
Although the three of them had already been assigned to the first team, head coach Dave Jones decided to come to see the training of the youth team in person to show his concern for the players. However, Wang Li asked for leave today...
